tasks.title: Confirm J-1 visa stamp in passport
tasks.description: Verify the J-1 visa was correctly stamped. Check entry dates, sponsor name (Placement International), and duration of status (D/S).
tasks.notes: If any error is found, contact DSO immediately. Do not wait.

tasks.title: Pick up passport from NACEX (Lisbon)
tasks.description: Collect passport from NACEX Point-of-Sale pickup point in Lisbon. Bring your ID (Cartao de Cidadao) and order confirmation.
tasks.notes: Track shipment on nacex.pt. NACEX Lisbon POS pickup locations: check confirmation email for assigned location.

tasks.title: Print DS-2019 form and keep original safe
tasks.description: DS-2019 (Certificate of Eligibility for J-1) is required at the US port of entry. Print two copies — one for carry-on, one for checked luggage.
tasks.notes: Never put the original in checked luggage. Carry it on your person at all times during travel.

tasks.title: Print SEVIS fee receipt (I-901)
tasks.description: Print the I-901 SEVIS fee payment receipt. US border agents may ask for it.
tasks.notes: Download from fmjfee.com using your SEVIS ID.

tasks.title: Make certified copies of all key documents
tasks.description: Photocopy and/or scan: passport (all pages), DS-2019, I-901 receipt, visa stamp page, health insurance card. Store digital copies in cloud.
tasks.notes: Upload scans to Google Drive or iCloud. Also email them to yourself.

tasks.title: Confirm sponsor/placement organization contacts
tasks.description: Save the 24/7 emergency phone number and email of your J-1 sponsor (Placement International) on your phone.
tasks.notes: You will need to contact your DSO within 5 days of arriving in the USA.

tasks.title: Book or confirm flight Lisbon → US hub → Honolulu → Lihue (LIH)
tasks.description: Confirm flight itinerary. Likely route: LIS → LAX/SFO/JFK → HNL → LIH. Ensure checked bag allowance covers gear.
tasks.notes: Hawaiian Airlines flies HNL → LIH multiple times daily. Budget 6-8 hours layover in mainland hub for customs/immigration clearance on first US entry.

tasks.title: Check-in online (24h before departure)
tasks.description: Do online check-in for all flight segments. Download boarding passes to phone AND print them.
tasks.notes: Set a phone alarm for 24h before departure. Have boarding passes in Apple Wallet or Google Pay as backup.

tasks.title: Confirm checked bag weight and dimensions for all segments
tasks.description: Verify each airline's checked bag policy for the full itinerary. Drone batteries must go in carry-on (FAA rules).
tasks.notes: US domestic airlines often allow 23kg (50lb) per bag. European legs may differ.

tasks.title: Book first 2 weeks accommodation in Kauai
tasks.description: Book Airbnb, hostel, or short-term rental in Kauai for Sept 22 - Oct 6. Kapaa or Lihue are central and affordable.
tasks.notes: Kauai accommodation books up fast. Consider: Kauai Beach House Hostel (Kapaa), Airbnb near Kapaa town. Budget $50-120/night.

tasks.title: Research medium-term housing options in Kauai
tasks.description: Start looking at monthly rentals or shared housing for after the first 2 weeks. Facebook Groups 'Kauai Housing' and Craigslist Kauai are useful.
tasks.notes: Kauai has a tight rental market. Average room in shared house: $800-1500/month.

tasks.title: Save Kauai emergency contacts (police, hospital, embassy)
tasks.description: Note: Wilcox Medical Center (main hospital), Kauai Police 911, Portuguese Consulate in Honolulu.
tasks.notes: Portuguese Consulate General in Honolulu: +1 (808) 521-4322. Wilcox Medical Center: +1 (808) 245-1100.

tasks.title: Set up Wise account and USD balance
tasks.description: Open Wise account if not done. Add funds, get USD balance. Order Wise debit card — takes 1-2 weeks to ship to Portugal.
tasks.notes: Order ASAP — allow 7-14 business days. Alternatively use Revolut with USD balance.

tasks.title: Notify Portuguese bank of international travel / USA move
tasks.description: Notify your bank of travel dates and USA destination to prevent card freezes.
tasks.notes: Do this 2-3 days before departure.

tasks.title: Open US bank account or plan ATM strategy
tasks.description: J-1 visa holders can open a US bank account. Charles Schwab (no ATM fees worldwide) is ideal for travelers.
tasks.notes: Charles Schwab High Yield Investor Checking reimburses all ATM fees worldwide. Can often open with passport + visa.

tasks.title: Carry USD cash for first days
tasks.description: Have at least $300-500 USD cash for first days in Kauai. Exchange before leaving Portugal.
tasks.notes: Exchange rate at airport is poor. Use Wise, Revolut, or a bank branch in Lisbon.

tasks.title: Get US phone plan — T-Mobile tourist SIM or eSIM
tasks.description: Buy T-Mobile tourist plan eSIM before departure. T-Mobile has best coverage in Hawaii.
tasks.notes: Keep Portuguese SIM active for WhatsApp/banking 2FA — use dual SIM if phone supports it.

tasks.title: Confirm phone is unlocked for US networks
tasks.description: Verify your phone is SIM-unlocked. Contact your Portuguese carrier (NOS/Vodafone/MEO) to unlock if needed.
tasks.notes: Most modern iPhones and flagship Androids support eSIM dual-SIM.

tasks.title: Set up VPN for accessing Portuguese content from USA
tasks.description: Subscribe to a VPN to access Portuguese streaming services and banking from abroad.
tasks.notes: Some Portuguese banks block logins from foreign IPs. VPN set to Portugal server solves this.

tasks.title: Confirm J-1 health insurance is active from Sept 22
tasks.description: Contact Placement International to confirm health insurance enrollment and coverage start date.
tasks.notes: J-1 requires minimum coverage: $100k medical, $25k repatriation. Get the insurance card and ID number before departure.

tasks.title: Get insurance card / policy number in writing
tasks.description: Request a physical or digital insurance card from your sponsor. Know the emergency number to call from USA.
tasks.notes: Keep a screenshot of the insurance card in your phone photos (accessible offline).

tasks.title: Pack 3-month supply of any regular medications
tasks.description: Get prescriptions extended for 3 months. Keep meds in carry-on in original labeled packaging.
tasks.notes: US pharmacies may not accept Portuguese prescriptions. Stock up before leaving.

tasks.title: Get vaccination record translated to English
tasks.description: If you have a vaccination card, get an English translation or EU Digital Certificate.
tasks.notes: Some employers or activities in the US may ask for vaccination records.

tasks.title: Draft first 3 Kauai posts / Reels concepts
tasks.description: Pre-plan first content: 'I moved to Hawaii' announcement, airport/arrival vlog, first Kauai beach/hike reel.
tasks.notes: Na Pali Coast, Hanalei Bay, Waimea Canyon are top locations. First post should be personal and emotional.

tasks.title: Make social media announcement about moving to Hawaii
tasks.description: Post a teaser/announcement on Instagram and TikTok. Build hype before leaving.
tasks.notes: Consider a 'countdown' story series in the last week. This move is a huge content milestone.

tasks.title: Set up content calendar for first month in Kauai (Sept 22 - Oct 22)
tasks.description: Plan posting schedule: minimum 3 Reels/week + daily stories.
tasks.notes: Engagement tends to spike on arrival content — post frequently in the first 2 weeks.

tasks.title: Charge and format all camera memory cards
tasks.description: Format all SD cards in camera. Charge camera batteries, drone battery, and all power banks. Test all equipment.
tasks.notes: Bring at least 256GB total SD card storage. Format cards in the camera to reduce corruption risk.

tasks.title: Research Kauai filming permits and drone regulations
tasks.description: Check FAA Part 107 rules for drone flying in Hawaii. Many Kauai beaches and state parks require permits.
tasks.notes: Register drone with FAA (faa.gov/uas) if over 250g — costs $5. B4Ufly app shows no-fly zones.

tasks.title: Pack camera kit (body, lenses, filters)
tasks.description: Pack: main camera body, wide-angle lens, 50mm or telephoto, ND/polarizing filters. Include lens cleaning kit.
tasks.notes: Camera gear goes in carry-on. Salt air in Kauai is hard on gear — bring silica gel packs.

tasks.title: Pack drone and accessories (carry-on, batteries in separate bags)
tasks.description: Drone batteries must go in carry-on (FAA rule). Pack drone, controller, spare props, and charging cables.
tasks.notes: FAA: LiPo batteries up to 160Wh allowed in carry-on. Most airlines limit 2-3 spare LiPo batteries.

tasks.title: Pack surf essentials (rash guard, board shorts, leash)
tasks.description: Pack surf-specific clothing. Kauai has rental shops if leaving board behind.
tasks.notes: Kauai board rental: ~$20-40/day. Recommend renting for first week, then buy used locally.

tasks.title: Pack hiking gear (trail shoes, rain jacket, hydration pack)
tasks.description: Kauai trails are muddy and wet. Waterproof trail runners, packable rain jacket, 1.5-2L hydration pack.
tasks.notes: Kauai north shore gets 400+ inches of rain/year. Waterproof gear is essential, not optional.

tasks.title: Pack power adapters (USA Type A plugs)
tasks.description: USA uses Type A plugs (120V/60Hz). Bring a universal adapter. All modern electronics are dual-voltage.
tasks.notes: Check your laptop and camera charger — most say '100-240V', so just a plug adapter is needed.

tasks.title: Pack reef-safe sunscreen (Hawaii law)
tasks.description: Hawaii bans oxybenzone and octinoxate sunscreens. Buy reef-safe SPF 50+ before departure.
tasks.notes: Reef-safe brands: Raw Elements, Badger, Thinksport. Cheaper to buy a stock in Portugal.

tasks.title: Set up mail forwarding or trusted person for Portuguese mail
tasks.description: Arrange for a family member to receive/scan mail sent to your Portuguese address.
tasks.notes: Important mail may include bank statements, tax documents (IRS Português), etc.

tasks.title: Inform Segurança Social of departure (if applicable)
tasks.description: If contributing to Portuguese social security, check obligations for extended absence.
tasks.notes: J-1 work programs may have specific tax treaty implications between Portugal and USA.

tasks.title: Back up laptop and external drives to cloud
tasks.description: Back up all work files, photos, and projects to Google Drive / iCloud / Backblaze before departure.
tasks.notes: Start backup early — it takes time. If your laptop is lost in transit, cloud backup is your safety net.
